title: Now Toasts
description: Your top songs with a like, play-next and queue on every row. Each action answers with a toast whose cover flies down from the row into it; the toasts stack like cards, fan out when you hover, pause while you read, and swipe away with a flick. Liking bursts the heart.
intent: A Sonner-style toast stack built for a music app: real covers, undo on every toast, swipe to dismiss with velocity, and a cover that flies from the row into its toast.
